author: Inside Edition
description: With Savannah Guthrie's absence from the "Today" show, people are asking if there are hidden messages within her new plea concerning her mother’s disappearance. Inside Edition spoke with former FBI special agent Dr. Brianna Fox. In the video, Guthrie says her family has done their part. Guthrie's recent plea comes nearly six months after her mother went missing from her Tucson, Arizona home. According to an FBI source, "We've made no progress here. We have no idea where Nancy is or who kidnapped her."
title: Savannah Guthrie Posts New Plea In Her Mother's Disappearance

author: Inside Edition
description: New videos show a single engine aircraft making a harrowing landing on Huntington Beach in Southern California. According to the pilot, the engine suddenly lost power, forcing him to make an emergency landing. Video captured by a camera beneath the plane shows its soft landing and the pilot skillfully avoiding all beachgoers. Inside Edition spoke with pilot Mike Bremner and his nephew Griffin, the sole passenger in his the two-seater Piper PA-28.
title: Video Shows Plane Making Emergency Landing On California Beach

author: Inside Edition
description: Effects from Tuesday morning's powerful earthquake in southern Japan were caught on camera. The epicenter of the quake, reported between 6.8 and 7.1, was near the city of Kumamoto, on the island of Kyushu. Aerial footage shows the aftermath of the seismic event. Emergency crews battled flames on one building. An explosion was reported at a shopping mall shortly after the quake, and people are reported to be trapped inside the structure.
title: People Huddle For Safety As Powerful Earthquake Shakes Japan

author: Inside Edition
description: A suspect was surrounded, but still tried to make a run for it, jumping in his vehicle despite having few routes to drive. The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office in Florida released bodycam videos of the arrest. They say the FBI and Georgia Bureau of Investigation tracked an allegedly kidnapped 13-year-old girl from Georgia to this motel. They say they ordered the suspect to surrender. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Dramatic Rescue Of Allegedly Kidnapped Teen Caught On Bodycam
